headword: {走行車線|そうこうしゃせん}

definitions.gloss: driving lane; travel lane; cruising lane
definitions.explanation: The left lane (in Japan) of a multi-lane road or expressway, intended for normal-speed driving. Contrasted with the passing lane.

examples.japanese: {走行車線|そうこうしゃせん}を{走|はし}ってください。
examples.english: Please drive in the travel lane.

examples.japanese: {追|お}い{越|こ}しが{終|お}わったら{走行車線|そうこうしゃせん}に{戻|もど}る。
examples.english: After passing, return to the driving lane.

examples.japanese: {高速道路|こうそくどうろ}では、{走行車線|そうこうしゃせん}を{基本|きほん}とし、{追越車線|おいこししゃせん}は{追|お}い{越|こ}し{時|じ}のみ{使用|しよう}する。
examples.english: On expressways, the driving lane is the default, and the passing lane should only be used when overtaking.

notes:
A compound of {走行|そうこう} (running, driving) + {車線|しゃせん} (lane). In Japan, where traffic drives on the left, the {走行車線|そうこうしゃせん} is the leftmost lane, and the {追越車線|おいこししゃせん} (passing lane) is on the right.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {走行車線|そうこうしゃせん}を{走|はし}る: to drive in the travel lane
- {走行車線|そうこうしゃせん}に{戻|もど}る: to return to the travel lane
- {走行車線|そうこうしゃせん}と{追越車線|おいこししゃせん}: travel lane and passing lane

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {追越車線|おいこししゃせん}: passing lane — the faster lane used for overtaking
- {車線|しゃせん}: lane — the general term for a traffic lane
- {路肩|ろかた}: road shoulder — the emergency strip alongside the road
